result.text: You went over the falls, and the brass bolt remains in the granite boulder, stamped VELL 1979. Tomas Lind’s register made it the reference for thirty stakes, measured every September. At the survey hut, the kettle is still on the shelf. A note pinned to the door says someone went up to look for the stakes, could not find them, and left the tea. Nobody signed it. I have left the note where it was. The river came down the valley by your route; the kettle waits on its shelf.
